setup_batch_predict_server: deploy a Ray Serve BatchPredictServer with an MLIPPredictUnit for batched molecular inference
BatchPredictServer_predict: run batched predictions on a list of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM splitting
BatchPredictServer_call: call the BatchPredictServer to get predictions for a single AtomicData system
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the max batch size and wait timeout for the BatchPredictServer deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into per-system prediction dictionaries
